batch_scope: artifact-gc, boot, and cockpit command groups

findings.observed_behavior: Read-only bootloader rendering; no writer, subprocess, local mutation, git mutation, or remote mutation path was observed.
Read-only generated-bootstrap and mandatory-source drift check; it may fail with exit code 1 but does not write or mutate repository state.
Read-only cockpit action selection rendering; no action is executed and no hidden state is written.

commands.observed_behavior: Dry-run by default for the default, tmp-log, transfer-run, and report-retention modes; executing modes delete only narrow registered transient, aged tmp, transfer-run, or report-retention artifacts. The local-tmp-contents mode is also bounded but writes a local GC report even during dry-run.
side_effects: process_execution: git status --porcelain checks whether exact next-turn working artifacts are untracked
local_bounded_write: unlink exact transient command files or untracked next-turn working artifacts only with --execute
local_bounded_write: unlink expired tmp logs only with --execute and only within the selected tmp root
local_bounded_write: unlink expired transfer-run reports only with --execute and never latest report names
local_bounded_write: unlink expired unreferenced report-retention artifacts only with --execute and only under allowed report roots
commands.dry_run_behavior: Default invocation renders collect_candidates output only. Mode-specific dry-runs return PENDING candidates without unlinking, except --local-tmp-contents also writes the local GC report artifact.

commands.observed_behavior: Renders mandatory boot source presence and workflow-rule guidance from repository files.
commands.dry_run_behavior: No separate dry-run flag; the command is render-only.

commands.observed_behavior: Writes the generated successor bootstrap projection to the requested path or workspace handoff path.
side_effects: local_bounded_write: writes docs/handoff/NEXT_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP.md or the explicitly requested output path
commands.dry_run_behavior: No dry-run flag; invoking the command writes the projection.

commands.observed_behavior: Checks generated bootstrap drift and mandatory boot-source presence; reports PASS/FAIL and exits nonzero on findings.
commands.dry_run_behavior: No separate dry-run flag; the command is check-only.

commands.observed_behavior: Executes cockpit registry actions after safety checks. Read-only actions are allowed by default; BOUNDED actions require --allow-bounded; DESTRUCTIVE and unknown-safety actions are blocked.
side_effects: process_execution: subprocess.run executes the resolved action command after registry and safety checks
blocked_destructive_candidate: destructive actions are never executed
blocked_bounded_default: bounded actions are not executed without explicit allow flag
commands.dry_run_behavior: No dry-run flag; default safety behavior blocks bounded and destructive actions while allowing read-only actions.

commands.observed_behavior: Renders the cockpit action list and next-step hints without executing any action.
commands.dry_run_behavior: No separate dry-run flag; the command is inspect-only.
